title: AskSolInvestigationResult
description: Structured, evidence-grounded findings from an independent read-only GPT-5.6 Sol investigation.

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version for ask_sol results

investigation_goal.description: The exact goal or question investigated

caller_hypothesis.description: Optional caller hypothesis, treated as untrusted

worktree_digest.description: Deterministic digest of the worktree identity

head_sha.description: HEAD commit SHA at investigation time

dirty_digest.description: Digest of uncommitted caller working tree state

finding.description: Core finding and evidence summary from Sol

path.description: Repository-relative file path or artifact location

evidence.description: First-party repository evidence locations and observations

rejected_alternatives.description: Plausible alternative hypotheses tested and rejected with evidence

confidence.description: Confidence level based on repository proof

unresolved.description: Unresolved uncertainties or remaining unproven assumptions

recommended_next_action.description: Recommended concrete next action for the caller worker
